description:
Perform a reliability analysis on the Agreeableness subscale (items A1, A2, A3, A4, A5) of the Big Five Personality Traits dataset found in '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/BigFivePersonalityTraits.csv'. 

IMPORTANT: Item A1 ('Am indifferent to the feelings of others') is reverse-coded and must be handled correctly in the analysis.

Required Actions:
1. Load the dataset in JASP.
2. Run a Reliability Analysis including items A1-A5.
3. Ensure A1 is marked as reverse-coded.
4. Enable 'McDonald's omega', 'Cronbach's alpha', 'Mean', and 'Standard deviation' under Scale Statistics.
5. Enable 'Cronbach's alpha (if item dropped)', 'McDonald's omega (if item dropped)', and 'Item-rest correlation' under Individual Item Statistics.
6. Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/Agreeableness_Reliability.jasp'.
7. Create a text report at '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/reliability_report.txt' using the format below:

Scale: Agreeableness (A1-A5)
Number of items: 5
Reverse-coded items: A1
Cronbach's Alpha: <value>
McDonald's Omega: <value>
Scale Mean: <value>
Scale SD: <value>
Weakest Item: <item name>
Alpha If Weakest Dropped: <value>

(Round metrics to 3 decimal places, Mean/SD to 2 decimal places)
